description: CommitStep (plan §20.1 step 14, §15.4; §22.3 steps 4-6 through the LibraryPort) and NotifyStep (step 18). Commit is skipped unless Plan and Seal ran; without Name's output it fails with name.noFolder; library.require(plan.libraryId) (an offline library fails with its reason); job.cancelled when the job is cancelled already; library.stagingDirectory. The unit's row (UnitRecord): Seal's unitId, the plan's library, no physical disc, the job, its path (Name's folder, or _Quarantine/<Name's name>), Seal's record file, version 3, committing, Seal's status, the identity (Name's when it corrected it, else Plan's: name, kind, format, formatCode, encrypted, its label's season, part, volume, disc), Probe's fingerprint, the label (the listing's name, else the source's: StepSources.label), Probe's MakeMKV version (else ''), the bytes and count of Seal's files, 1 attempt, created now. The intent: Seal's unitId, the job, staging, <library>/<that path>, merge (Name's, never for a quarantine), not quarantine, created now, items: Name's files in order, each in place (from = to = its path, without a final '/'; a folder when Seal has no file of that path, else a file with Seal's SHA-256), then Seal's record, logs and note (no SHA-256). The files: Seal's. Seal's tag set: library.quarantine(unit, intent, files, tag, the job's cancel token), log commit.quarantined{path: the destination} (warning), StepReport.quarantined; else library.commit(..., cancel), log archive.moved{count: the items, path: the destination}. Before the call, progress archive.moving at 0. Data: CommitOutput {unitId, library, path: the destination relative to the library, merged (the result's), quarantined}. Resources: libraryWrites [plan.libraryId]; resumability idempotent (plan §20.1's 'rolls forward': LibraryService finishes an open intent). Notify: data {}, no resources, idempotent, nothing else. The harness runs CommitStep (or NotifyStep) alone with fakes and an in-memory file system holding given.taken (the folders already in the library: the step lists the parent of a folder the library says is taken). The fake LibraryPort: require(lib) gives {id, path} from given.libraries, throws the library's 'offline' error, or library.notFound; stagingDirectory(lib, job) requires the library, then gives <path>/.bromelia/staging/<job> (and counts the call); commit(unit, intent, files, cancel) and quarantine(unit, intent, files, tag, cancel) record the call, then (cancelAt commit) cancel the job and fail with job.cancelled when the token they were given is cancelled (LibraryService's wait does so), then fail with port.errors[n] for the n-th call when it is given and not null, else with port.error when given, else give CommitResult{unit.id, destination: port.destination, else quarantine: <the intent destination's parent>/<its last part> [<tag>], commit: the intent's destination; the files given; merged: port.merged, else commit: the intent's merge, quarantine: false}. A fixed clock (now). given: step "commit" (default) | "notify" request, outputs ([{kind, data, readErrors?}]), now libraries {lib: {path, offline?: {code, params}}} port {error?: {code, params}, errors?: [{code, params} | null] (by call), destination?: path, merged?: bool} taken [absolute folders that exist in the library (H3b-2)] cancelAt {op: "start"}: the job is cancelled before the step runs; {op: "commit"}: when the port's commit or quarantine is called expect: error {code, params}, skipped, quarantined (StepReport.quarantined; default false), data (exactly), log (exactly: code, params, severity), progress (exactly: [fraction, code]), calls (exactly: the port's commit / quarantine calls), stagingAsked (how many times stagingDirectory was called), resources {libraryWrites}, resumes {resumability} A call: {op: commit|quarantine, tag (quarantine only), unit, intent, files}. unit {id, libraryId, physicalDiscId, jobId, path, recordFile, recordVersion, state, status, name, kind, format, formatCode, encrypted, fingerprint, label, season, part, volume, disc, makemkvVersion, bytes, fileCount, attempts, createdAt, committedAt} (UnitRecord, in its order; enums by their wire names, instants formatted) intent {unitId, jobId, staging, destination, merge, quarantine, createdAt, items: [[seq, from, to, sha256, isDir, moved]]} files [[path, size, sha256, role, title]]
